headline: Why our model backs Charlotte
caption:
Brooklyn has home court. Our model still likes Charlotte. Here's why.

The big bar is recent point differential: it moves our prediction 7.0 points toward the Hornets. Team efficiency nudges 0.3 toward the Nets and tonight's players nudge 0.3 back toward Charlotte, so those two basically cancel out. Start from the average game (home team by 2.3) and that one factor flips it.

The pick: Charlotte Hornets, 66% to win at Brooklyn. Not a lock. Brooklyn wins this about a third of the time.

Is recent form the right thing to trust this early, or does home court matter more?
